name: Regional Administrative Court for Lombardy (TAR Lombardia), order no. 1208/2022 – PM10 conflict of jurisdiction

jurisdiction.court: Regional Administrative Court for Lombardy (TAR Lombardia), Section III

description: Order by which the TAR Lombardia, before which the Milanese citizen had resumed the proceedings after the ordinary Tribunal had declined jurisdiction (judgment 3364/2021), raised a negative conflict of jurisdiction before the Joint Divisions of the Court of Cassation, maintaining that the infringement of the fundamental right to health resulting from the systematic exceedances of PM10 required the case to be heard by the ordinary court.
outcome: The conflict was resolved by the Joint Divisions with order no. 5668/2023, which affirmed the jurisdiction of the ordinary court, recognising the nature of the right to health as a subjective right even in the face of the failure to exercise the administrative power to protect air quality.
